source_cross_checks.finding: Thesis and Congress narrative report 17 sites, whereas the supplied sites.csv contains 21.
source_cross_checks.action: Publish an explicit versioned inclusion/exclusion list; do not assume 17=21.

source_cross_checks.finding: Thesis reports 9 criteria and 25/27 points; CSV has six ordinal columns 1..5 and 25/30 for Большой Камень.
source_cross_checks.action: Keep these methodologies separate until original nine-criterion scorecard is sourced.

source_cross_checks.finding: Thesis cites 80–85% capacity factor; Congress paragraph 4.2 uses 90%; scenario currently assumes 85%.
source_cross_checks.action: Perform scenario sensitivity; state capacity factor explicitly.

source_cross_checks.finding: Thesis and cost amortization use 60 years; reactor catalogue gives СВБР-100 50 years.
source_cross_checks.action: Keep catalogue service life in the base case and 60 years as a transparent what-if only.

source_cross_checks.finding: Congress mentions 500–800 MW regional deficit; this is not demonstrated contracted demand for a site.
source_cross_checks.action: Obtain local hourly consumption, grid capacity and offtake terms; keep scenario_demo illustrative.

source_cross_checks.finding: Economics workbook cell A5 says port Korsakov while cell B5 describes Большой Камень.
source_cross_checks.action: Resolve location and verify cost item against logistics estimates.

source_cross_checks.finding: Technology catalog and concept documents are not independent evidence of installed cost or licensing.
source_cross_checks.action: Require vendor references and regulatory engineering review outside this software.
